title.zh: C 在各读法下的排序：逐步读法保持“共享优于以消耗取胜”，在二元定律族中保持节制优于过度汲取；过度汲取者在损失之前有被记入的事件时，失去“没有它更好”
title.en: What C ranks under each reading: the stepwise reading keeps “sharing is better than winning by consumption” and, in the two-part family, restraint above overdraw, and loses “better without the overdrawing formation” when that formation has a credited event before the loss

claim.zh: 把两次继续作为一个框架的配置、把读法所记入的事件作为实现的主张，比较原则 C 就是这一框架上的 Comparison。对任何只记入活跃事件的读法，没有某个形成的继续扩展有它的继续，仅当读法扣下该形成的每个事件。整段读法（活跃且在该继续中不消耗）下，对支持门控定律族中每个超出更新地汲取的焦点形成，没有它的继续扩展有它的继续，所以每个满足 C 的比较都把前者排得更高。逐步读法（活跃且不侵蚀）下，焦点形成在某步活跃、而该步之后每个所需仍被满足时，这一事件被记入；于是两次继续互不扩展，有一个满足 C、非自反、传递的比较偏好有它的继续。恶性增殖与以消耗取胜都是实例。逐步读法下，以消耗取胜者在损失之前的事件被记入、之后的不被记入，而共享的继续记入每个事件，所以共享仍扩展以消耗取胜。在二元定律族中，两种读法下，每个所需始终被满足的继续（节制）都扩展同一族中过度汲取使维持者失去支持的继续，所以每个满足 C 的比较都把节制排得更高，即使逐步读法记入过度汲取者在损失之前的事件；恶性增殖与同一形成在第一步之后、越过阈值之前停止相比也是如此。所以在二元定律族中，逐步读法下 C 失去与不在场的比较，保留与每步都满足所需的继续的比较。焦点形成没有被记入的事件时（例如第一步就越过支持），逐步读法同样把不在场排得更高（Immediate）；有第三个形成共用条件时，节制者此后的汲取可以侵蚀第三者曾被满足的依存，逐步读法下两次继续互不扩展（ThirdParty）。不用 Lean 公理；C 只作为假设或定义出现。
claim.en: Taking two continuations as the configurations of a frame and the events a reading credits as its realized claims, comparison principle C is Comparison on that frame. For any reading that credits only active events, the continuation without a formation extends the continuation with it only if the reading withholds every event of that formation. Under the whole-run reading (active and not consuming in that continuation), for every law of the support-gated family in which the focal formation draws beyond renewal, the continuation without it extends the continuation with it, so every comparison satisfying C ranks the former higher. Under the stepwise reading (active and not undermining), an event of the focal formation is credited when it is active and every need is still met after its step; the two continuations then do not extend each other, and an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the continuation with the formation. Malignant growth and winning by consumption are instances. Under the stepwise reading the winner's events before the loss are credited and those after are not, while sharing credits every event, so sharing still extends winning by consumption. In the two-part family, under both readings a continuation in which every need stays met (restraint) extends a continuation of the family in which overdraw ends the sustaining formation's support, so every comparison satisfying C ranks restraint higher, even though the stepwise reading credits the overdrawing formation's events before the loss; so it is for malignant growth against the same formation stopping after its first step, before the threshold. So in the two-part family the stepwise reading loses the comparison with absence and keeps the comparison with a course that meets every need at every step. When no focal event is credited, as when the first step already crosses support, the stepwise reading too ranks the absence higher (Immediate); when a third formation shares the condition, a restrained formation's later draw can undermine the third formation's once-met dependence, and under the stepwise reading neither course extends the other (ThirdParty). No Lean axiom is used; C occurs only as a hypothesis or a definition.

hypotheses.zh: C 是公开的比较前提，本结果不证明它；“没有焦点形成的继续”与 relational-reading-comparison 相同，其水平由同一定律在焦点形成不出现时给出。
hypotheses.en: C is a disclosed comparison premise, not proved here; the continuation without the focal formation is the one of relational-reading-comparison, its levels given by the same law when the focal formation does not occur.

hypotheses.zh: 逐步读法的结论需要焦点形成有一个使每个所需仍被满足的活跃步；支持门控定律族的前提（所需为正、焦点所需不超过维持者所需、起点支持维持者、从某步起汲取超出更新）如 relational-renewal-classification 所设。
hypotheses.en: The stepwise conclusion needs an active step of the focal formation after which every need is still met; the premises of the support-gated family (positive need, focal need within the sustaining need, a start supporting the sustaining formation, drawing beyond renewal from some step on) are those of relational-renewal-classification.

hypotheses.zh: 节制的结论只在二元定律族（焦点形成与维持者）中、对每步都满足所需的停止定律证明；多一个共用条件的形成时它可以不成立（ThirdParty）。
hypotheses.en: The restraint conclusion is proved only in the two-part family (the focal and the sustaining formation) and for a stopping law that meets every need at every step; with one more formation sharing the condition it can fail (ThirdParty).

correspondence.zh: 两个排序在逐步读法下分道。若 G0 与 C 共用逐步读法，C 仍把共享排在以消耗取胜之上，却不再把没有恶性增殖的继续排得更高；整段读法两者都保持，代价是独立审查的判据 (b) 与 (c)。若 G0 的记入取逐步读法而 C 取整段读法，两者都保持，但 G0 与 C 不再共用一种 living 读法：形式上两者各以读法为参数，前提卡上 C 所说的“活的内容”却是 G0 的 living，分开取须公开。哪一种是生生的读法，由 Ren 选择。在二元定律族中，两种读法下 C 都把在阈值之前的节制排在过度汲取之上，所以那里逐步读法的代价是与不在场的比较，且只对在损失之前有被记入事件的形成；有第三个形成共用条件时，与节制的比较也可以失去（ThirdParty）。
correspondence.en: The two rankings part ways under the stepwise reading. If G0 and C share the stepwise reading, C still ranks sharing above winning by consumption but no longer ranks the continuation without malignant growth higher; the whole-run reading keeps both, at the cost of the independent review's criteria (b) and (c). If G0's credit takes the stepwise reading and C the whole-run reading, both are kept, but G0 and C no longer share one reading of living: formally each takes its reading as a parameter, while the premise card reads C's “living content” as G0's living, so a split must be disclosed. Which reading is the reading of 生生 is Ren's choice. In the two-part family C ranks restraint before the threshold above overdraw under both readings, so the cost of the stepwise reading there is the comparison with absence, and only for a formation with a credited event before the loss; with a third formation sharing the condition the comparison with restraint can be lost too (ThirdParty).

detail.zh: whole_run_extends 在核心上重述该结果的 overdraw_relational_extension；桥接的 Ranking.wholeRun_iff 与 Ranking.undisturbed_eq 表明读法与不在场继续的水平就是该结果的。
detail.en: whole_run_extends restates that result's overdraw_relational_extension on the core; the bridge's Ranking.wholeRun_iff and Ranking.undisturbed_eq show that the reading and the levels of the continuation without the formation are that result's.

output.zh: 整段读法下的不在场继续与 C 的排序。
output.en: The continuation without the formation and C's ranking under the whole-run reading.

input.zh: 两种读法下排序的比较。
input.en: The comparison of rankings under the two readings.

conditions.zh: 支持门控定律族的前提。
conditions.en: The premises of the support-gated family.

detail.zh: stepwise 恰是 Web.valuation 的 living（stepwise_iff），经 Web.static 读取定律的展开。
detail.en: stepwise is exactly the living of Web.valuation (stepwise_iff), reading the law's unfolding through Web.static.

detail.zh: 直接复用支持门控定律、overdraw_consuming、within_renewal_sustains 与 malignant、winning、sharing 三个定律。
detail.en: Directly reuses the support-gated law, overdraw_consuming, within_renewal_sustains and the laws malignant, winning and sharing.

output.zh: 定律、过度汲取的消耗与维持者的永久失去支持。
output.en: The law, consumption by overdraw and the sustaining formation's permanent loss of support.

input.zh: 两种读法下的两对继续。
input.en: Two pairs of continuations under the two readings.

detail.zh: 扣下过度汲取者在损失之前的事件需要知道运行此后怎样继续；该结果表明，由有限前缀决定的读法一般做不到。
detail.en: Withholding an overdrawing formation's events before the loss needs to know how the run continues; that result shows that readings fixed by a finite prefix cannot in general.

detail.zh: 在 C 之外，J1 的基本条件优先是可能给出“没有恶性增殖更好”的更强比较之一；这里未形式化这一连接。
detail.en: Beyond C, J1's priority of basic conditions is one stronger comparison that might yield “better without malignant growth”; this connection is not formalized here.

detail.zh: 逐步读法下 C 不决定恶性增殖与其不在场（malignant_ranking）：有一个满足 C、非自反、传递的比较偏好有恶性增殖的继续。这不是说在场更好，只是说 C 单独不足。
detail.en: Under the stepwise reading C does not decide between malignant growth and its absence (malignant_ranking): an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the continuation with it. This does not say the occurrence is better, only that C alone is insufficient.

detail.zh: 没有被记入的焦点事件时，逐步读法同样把不在场排得更高（Ranking.Immediate.stepwise_ranks_absence）：第一步就越过支持的形成，在两种读法下都排在其不在场之下；逐步读法的代价因此只涉及在损失之前有被记入事件的形成（第三次独立审查 G3）。
detail.en: When no focal event is credited, the stepwise reading too ranks the absence higher (Ranking.Immediate.stepwise_ranks_absence): a formation whose first step already crosses support ranks below its absence under both readings, so the stepwise cost concerns only formations with a credited event before the loss (third independent review G3).

detail.zh: 节制的结论不推广到第三个共用者（Ranking.ThirdParty.restraint_unranked_stepwise）：第三个形成只在水平 7 被支持；节制的继续中水平一度到 7，节制者此后的汲取侵蚀第三者曾被满足的依存，而过度汲取的继续中第三者从未被满足，同一事件被记入（ThirdParty.focal_three）；逐步读法下两次继续互不扩展，扩展本身是一个满足 C 而不把节制排得更高的比较；整段读法下节制仍扩展过度汲取（第三次独立审查 G4）。
detail.en: The restraint conclusion does not extend to a third co-drawer (Ranking.ThirdParty.restraint_unranked_stepwise): a third formation is supported only at level 7; in the restrained course the level reaches 7 once and the restrained formation's later draw undermines the third formation's once-met dependence, while in the overdrawing course the third formation is never met and the same event is credited (ThirdParty.focal_three); under the stepwise reading neither course extends the other, and extension itself is a comparison satisfying C that does not rank restraint higher; under the whole-run reading restraint still extends overdraw (third independent review G4).

detail.zh: 第三次独立审查：P8、P9 与 P7b 的全部声明接受，公理报告为空；MetSince 须比较那一步的所需（已修正），依存中断一步即开始新的一段（已披露），but-for 须动作可取（已修正）；散文在逐步读法的代价、节制、替代、交互与剩余的免费连通上强于 Lean（已更正，整合文档 §12）。
detail.en: Third independent review: every P8, P9 and P7b declaration is accepted with empty axiom reports; MetSince had to compare the need at that step (repaired), a one-step lapse starts a new tenure (disclosed), and but-for needs the move to be available (repaired); the prose overclaimed on the stepwise cost, restraint, substitution, interaction and the residual free connection (corrected, integration note §12).

limitations.zh: 只在支持门控定律族（二元：焦点形成与维持者）与三对比较继续（在场／不在场、共享／以消耗取胜、停止／过度汲取）中证明；第三个形成的见证（ThirdParty）表明节制的结论不推广到多个共用者；关系层读法同样记入焦点形成的第一个关系，但未单独形式化；不推出责任、义务或可行性；不选择读法。
limitations.en: Proved only in the support-gated family (two parts: the focal and the sustaining formation) and for three pairs of compared continuations (occurs/absent, sharing/winning, stops/overdraws); the third-party witness (ThirdParty) shows the restraint conclusion does not extend to several co-drawers; the relation-level reading also credits the focal formation's first relation but is not formalized separately; yields no responsibility, duty or feasibility; chooses no reading.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261010T180948.563939Z）：Becoming.Ranking 27 项定理与 Becoming.Bridge 的 Ranking.wholeRun_iff、Ranking.undisturbed_eq 全部空依赖；同一回执覆盖包内 35 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 1788 项定理／2748 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致。作者反审见整合文档 §9；第二次独立审查（BECOMING-P7-REVIEW.md）只在其问题 4 所涉范围内读了本结果，并预期了节制的结论，本记录据此新增 restraint_ranks 与 malignant_restraint；第三次独立审查（BECOMING-P8-P9-P7B-REVIEW.md，另一 agent，Claude Opus 5.5，未参与撰写）审查了全部结果，接受其数学，把节制的结论限于二元定律族，并给逐步读法的代价补上被记入事件的假设，其更正在整合文档 §12 处理。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 37 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261010T180948.563939Z): the 27 theorems of Becoming.Ranking and the bridge's Ranking.wholeRun_iff and Ranking.undisturbed_eq all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 35 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 1788 theorems/2748 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts. The author's counterreview is in §9 of the integration note. The second independent review (BECOMING-P7-REVIEW.md) read this result only as far as its question 4 required and anticipated the restraint result, which this record added as restraint_ranks and malignant_restraint. A third independent review (BECOMING-P8-P9-P7B-REVIEW.md, by a separate agent, Claude Opus 5.5, not an author) reviewed the whole result, accepted its mathematics, scoped the restraint conclusion to the two-part family and supplied the credited-event hypothesis to the stepwise cost; its corrections are handled in §12. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 37 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

next_delta.zh: Ren 选择 G0 与 C 是否共用一种读法、取哪一种；二元定律族之外（有多个共用者，或带数量使不取者不侵蚀）的节制定理；形式化关系层读法下的同一比较；检验 J1 的基本条件优先能否在逐步读法下给出“没有恶性增殖更好”。
next_delta.en: Ren's choice whether G0 and C share one reading, and which; a restraint theorem beyond the two-part family (with co-drawers, or with amounts so that a formation taking nothing does not undermine); the same comparison under the relation-level reading; whether J1's priority of basic conditions yields “better without malignant growth” under the stepwise reading.
